features.name: Telemetry gaps: whole gate names, failing tests, session ids, tool errors and denials, weekly rework, no duplicate trace rows
features.description: From the 2026-10-19 log review (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-telemetry-gaps-design.md, T1-T10). Gate-run rows keep a failed gate's full name (runtime drift was split in two), list the failing test files, and carry CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; verify-gate rows carry the hook input's session_id; outside-agent attempt rows carry repo and session. Run records count failed tool calls (is_error) and permission denials (toolDenialKind), keep only test file names, and leave out rows that name another session. harness_weekly.py adds a Rework section (a fix changing code another commit changed in the 48 h before). A second trace snapshot of one commit and agent replaces the first. State layer back under 6,000 tokens (feat-061..086 to progress-archive.md, feat-085..088 to docs/archive/features). The review rule adds a per-group review for long hook/gate/install branches; hangar AGENTS.md gets a Tier 3 section; Claude Code keeps transcripts 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: each change has a test that failed first
a real gate run row names runtime drift whole and the session
a real run record of this session shows tool errors and denials
the rework section runs on all three repos
the state layer is under its token limit
all 11 harness gates pass after deploy (runtime drift needs install.sh)

features.name: agy reviews held by an allowlist, not --dangerously-skip-permissions; fresh context counts as independent; two-subagent review rule
features.description: An agy review run with --dangerously-skip-permissions --mode plan ran install.sh. Reviews now run `agy --model gemini-3.8-flash-high --effort high -p` (model pinned by the owner), held by AGY_REVIEW_ALLOW, which `outside-agent.sh allow-agy` (called by install.sh) merges into ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json, keeping its mode. git log/diff/show/ls-files/blame pass only through one strict command(regex:...) rule of listed flags, pipes into grep/head/tail/wc and quoting that expands nothing; a quoted git argument may not start with '-'. A refused tool ends agy's run with no answer: outside-agent now returns its stderr as an error and logs the reason 'tool refused'. Reviews set OUTSIDE_AGENT_PURPOSE=review, and stop-verify.sh and agent-hook.sh skip the Stop gates for them (the gates failed on the change under review and kept agy going for 1,734 s). Owner decisions: a fresh context makes a reviewer independent whatever its family (exit 3 removed); high-risk changes get two subagents in parallel, an outside agent is optional and never holds the commit.
acceptance_criteria: agy reviews run without --dangerously-skip-permissions, on gemini-3.8-flash-high
the git rule refuses --output, quoted flags, chaining, $() and backticks, and allows ordinary review commands
a refused tool is reported with its reason, not as an empty answer
Stop gates do not run inside an outside-agent review
a same-family review exits 0 and is logged as independent
the shipped review rule names two subagents and an optional outside agent

features.name: agy review commands confined to the repo
features.description: Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-agy-review-paths-design.md. The nine prefix rules (cat, head, tail, grep, ls, wc, git status/rev-parse/merge-base) took any argument and any pipe: cat /etc/hosts, git diff -O /etc/hosts and git status | cat /etc/hosts ran live. AGY_REVIEW_ALLOW is now two command(regex:...) rules: no argument may start with /, ~ or = (zsh expands =ls to /bin/ls), have a .. path part or hold a glob; a quoted one may not start with - or contain ..; git ranges (HEAD~1..HEAD, main...HEAD) still pass. allow-agy removes the rules it retired (the prefix rules and older shapes of its own regex rules) and keeps the user's other rules.
acceptance_criteria: outside reads by absolute, home, =name, .. and glob paths are refused, quoted or not, in pipes too
ordinary review commands inside the repo and git ranges still run
allow-agy removes its retired rules and keeps the user's own
live agy run refuses the outside reads and runs the ordinary commands
features.evidence: Tests first: test_agy_review_commands_stay_inside_the_repo, test_agy_review_note_names_every_allowed_command and test_allow_agy_removes_the_rules_it_retired failed on the old rules; 209 passed, 1 skipped after. Mutations (leading / allowed, .. part allowed, retired rules kept) each fail a test. Live agy 1.4.3: 6 ordinary commands ran, 12 outside reads refused (cat /etc/hosts, cat '/etc/hosts', ls .., ls ~, ls .*, grep -c localhost /etc/hosts, git diff -O /etc/hosts, git status | cat /etc/hosts, git log -- /etc, head -c 20 =ls, git diff --stat =ls =cat, cat ../x). Live allow-agy: 10 rules removed, 2 added, mode 600 kept. Two subagent reviews (security, correctness) both found zsh =name expansion (cat =ls read /bin/ls); fixed with a failing test. Correctness review also found the note misdescribing quoted arguments and allow-agy removing a user's own command(regex:^git (fetch|pull)$); both fixed, the latter with a failing test. No re-review: the fixes removed a character and narrowed three prefixes. Symlinks: none tracked point outside in the three repos; untracked pack-skill links point to skill folders. Refused now that ran before: grep long options (--include=), globs, quoted patterns with .. or a backslash. Same round: certifi 2026.10.19 for PYSEC-2026-4320 (4325a9c).
